strategies.name: Detection of System Network Configuration Discovery

analytics.name: Analytic 1706
analytics.guidance: For Android, detect System Network Configuration Discovery by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate API Calls via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: NetworkInterface.getNetworkInterfaces()]; Application State via Android Enterprise / EMM [Managed package inventory/status and package metadata]; Network Connection Creation via Android Enterprise Network Logging / Enterprise VPN [DevicePolicyManager.retrieveNetworkLogs(): DnsEvent / ConnectEvent; VPN flow metadata]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

tuning.description: Network diagnostic, MDM agent apps. Minimal.

log_sources.name: android:EMM
log_sources.channel: Managed package inventory/status and package metadata

analytics.name: Analytic 1707
analytics.guidance: For iOS, detect System Network Configuration Discovery by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate Application State via Apple MDM [InstalledApplicationList / ManagedApplicationList]; Host Status via Apple MDM [DeviceInformation / SecurityInfo / ProfileList / restrictions and compliance queries]; Network Traffic Flow via Apple Network Extension / Enterprise VPN [NEFilterFlow / per-app VPN / secure-web-gateway flow metadata]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

tuning.description: Default 10KB — network config fingerprint is small.
Default 600s after jailbreak detection while on enterprise network.

log_sources.name: iOS:MDM
log_sources.channel: DeviceInformation / SecurityInfo / ProfileList / restrictions and compliance queries

log_sources.name: iOS:NetworkExtension
log_sources.channel: NEFilterFlow / per-app VPN / secure-web-gateway flow metadata
